title: VHS Horror dynamacam
description: analog horror effects to the camera
body:
**VHS Horror Type Camera Movement**
_(I RECOMMEND INSTALLING MY KYBUS SHADERS PRESENT AND RESHADE TO PAIR WITH SHADERS)_
### YOU CAN STACK SHADERS ON TOP OF IT
### I ALSO HIGHLY RECOMMEND YOU TURN MUSIC OFF
```
https://github.com/Cubix-X-Industries-LLC/VHSRESHADE
```
{JUST INSTALL THE LATEST GITHUB RELEASE AND CHOOSE YOUR PROFILE WHEN YOU OPEN THE .exe FILE}

### Features:

* VHS-style camera shake and instability
* subtle static / buzzing effects
* designed for analog horror immersion

Recommended Setup:

* Use with Kybus shaders + ReShade
* Disable in-game music for full effect

Compatibility:

* TACZ
* Presence Footsteps (Forge)
* AmbientSounds
* pretty much everything else contact my github if you need compatibility changes.

Installation:
Download the latest release from GitHub and select your profile when launching the .exe once again the 
link: https://github.com/Cubix-X-Industries-LLC/VHSRESHADE
